kate.p: AuroraAI trial ends Friday. Procurement needs clear billing lines before we sign a 12mo commit. Can someone paste the sanitized invoice?
ryan: Pulled it. Main things: per-call, token, and an "indexing" fee for vector ingestion.
lucy: paste pls so we can map to our SKUs.
ryan: Snippet (sanitized):
```
AURORAAI CALLS: 1,120 calls @ $0.028/call = $31.36
AURORAAI TOKENS: 610,400 tokens @ $0.0007/token = $427.28
AURORAAI INDEX-INGEST: 9,600 vectors @ $0.0019/vector = $18.24
REGIONAL SURCHARGE (EUR): $6.00
TOTAL = $482.88
```
kate.p: Procurement asks: 1) CSV price sheet with sku_id + counts_toward_commit flag; 2) PO + Net45 support? 3) trial credit handling (we used $2k).
omar (AuroraAI): Hi all : We can provide a CSV with sku_id, unit, unit_price, counts_toward_commit. PO + Net45 ok for 12mo commits >= $50k. Trial credits applied as one-time invoice credit on conversion; they don't reduce commit minimum.
ryan: Tokenization mismatch? Our tool shows ~4% delta in counts.
omar (AuroraAI): We use a GPT-like BPE tokenizer; will attach a tokenizer script and can sign a reconciliation addendum to accept Redwood counts with a short audit window.
finance-bot: Reminder: vendor risk questionnaire pending (https://vendor-portal.redwood.com/risk/auroraai) assigned to @lucy and @legal.team. Due in 5 days.
lucy: Ok next steps: @omar please upload CSV + tokenizer script, confirm PO/Net45 policy in writing, and include a sample machine-readable invoice. If we get CSV today I can run a 60-day projection and post numbers here by EOD.
